title: MedLatinEpi and MedLatinLit: Two Datasets for the Computational Authorship Analysis of Medieval Latin Texts
reasoning: The paper's focus is on computational stylometry for authorship verification of historical Latin texts. While some of the source texts may have religious themes or authors (e.g., Clara Assisiensis), the research itself does not evaluate or benchmark any aspect of religion, faith, morals, or ethics. The analysis is purely linguistic.
